question: Who among the following has written the book ‘Manohar Parrikar - Off the Record’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Waman S Prabhu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pramod Sawant**, the **Chief Minister of Goa**, **released** book titled **"Manohar Parrikar- Off the Record."**
 
• **Waman Subha Prabhu,** a distinguished journalist, penned the book.
 
• This book is a collection of memories from **Mr Prabhu**, who was with late Parrikar throughout his life's journey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **R Kaushik:**

 
 
• He is one of** India’s respected cricket writers** with nearly three decades of experience.
 
• He is currently based in Bengaluru as a** freelance writer.**
 
• **"India's 71-Year Test: The Journey to Triumph in Australia" **is written by him.
 
• He is also a co-author of** VVS Laxman's **award-winning autobiography **"281 and Beyond",** which was published in November 2018. 
 
 
 
• **SY Quraishi:**
 
 
• Shahabuddin Yaqoob Quraishi, the **17th Chief Election Commissioner of India**, is an Indian civil servant. On** July 30, 2010,** he was appointed as the CEC, **succeeding Navin Chawla.**
 
• He has also worked for the** Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports **as a **Secretary.**
 
• **"An Undocumented Wonder: The Making of India's Great Election" **and **"The Population Myth: Islam, Family Planning, and Politics in India"** are two of his books.
